## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: ripgrep + Glob inventory committed as audit artifact
- dd-2: each reference classified as {remove, redirect, document-as-historical}; classification table

## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] Audit doc exists at docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md
  Verify: test -f docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md
- [ ] Audit doc contains a Classification Rubric section defining each bucket with at least one worked example per bucket
  Verify: grep -qE '^##.*[Rr]ubric' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md && for b in remove redirect document-as-historical; do grep -q \"$b\" docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Audit table classification column values are exactly one of {remove, redirect, document-as-historical}
  Verify: grep -qE '\| (remove|redirect|document-as-historical) \|' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md
- [ ] Audit covers all three retired symbols
  Verify: grep -q 'bridge_state' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md && grep -q 'prev_snapshot' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md && grep -q 'mapping.json' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md
- [ ] Sibling tickets referenced for scope clarity
  Verify: grep -q '2f51-e59f' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md && grep -q '9e3f-3208' docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md

## Implementation Notes

docs/findings/ exists (verified). Create docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md with three sections:

### Section 1: Classification Rubric (NEW per plan-review F3)
Define each bucket with worked examples:
- **remove**: production code path that writes/reads the retired state. Sibling 2f51-e59f-5e0d-41fe owns the actual removal. Examples: prev_snapshot reads in reconcile.py line N; mapping.json writes in applier.py line N.
- **redirect**: code path whose semantic intent must be preserved but rewired to the stateless equivalent. Examples: prev_snapshot empty→populated 'first-run' detection → rewired to alert_store 'seen-this-env-before' check (note: sibling 2f51 likely owns the actual rewire; this story classifies the call sites).
- **document-as-historical**: documentation, comments, test fixture names, or findings docs that mention retired terms for historical context only. Examples: docs/findings/3a03-recovery-session*.md mentions; CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md retired-key sentences.
Add 2-3 worked example rows per bucket.

### Section 2: Inventory
Run rg over the repo for bridge_state, prev_snapshot, mapping.json. Pre-discovery counts to reconcile: bridge_state ~20+ files, prev_snapshot 5 files, mapping.json 9 files, .github/workflows/ 0 hits.

### Section 3: Classification Table
Columns: path | line | symbol | classification | note. Apply the rubric verbatim — every row's classification value must be one of the three bucket names.

### Section 4: Sibling-ticket scope
Header section names sibling tickets 2f51-e59f-5e0d-41fe (code removal — they execute remove/redirect rows) and 9e3f-3208-af65-4b34 (orchestrator topology) so the audit's scope (consumer enumeration only) is unambiguous.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN docs: residual-bridge-state audit doc with classification rubric + inventory
